mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have lovely clear skies and a temperature of 75 degrees, making it a perfect afternoon to visit Reddan Soccer Park. We are currently under a Waxing Gibbous moon.

The City of Verona is seeking an Engineering Technician to manage various public works projects through September 20, 2026. Additionally, residents can apply for a 30 dollar rebate on rain barrels by submitting a form to 410 Investment Court.

We have plenty of activity this weekend, including the Dane County Farmers Market today, live music at several local venues like Paddy Mac's today, and a free Girls Try Hockey event tomorrow at the Verona Ice Arena.
On Friday, August 15, officers performed a traffic stop after a report of a driver swerving, which resulted in an arrest for an O W I, first offence.
Enjoy a scoop of Raspberry Cheesecake today while Culver's is open until 10:30 PM. Also, you can find Kona Ice at the Verona Area High School football game starting at 6 PM this evening.
